content.body:
brief1 = American forces must defend the fuel dump north of town from German armor. This fuel is vital to the invasion plan! Bridges must be captured with armor. brief2 = German forces capture the fuel dump north of town with armor. Re-taking it will blunt the Allied advance! Bridges must be captured with armor. onspawn.alliedinfantry1 = Capture and hold both bridges and defend the fuel dump. onspawn.moveout.2 = Capture and hold both bridges and recapture the fuel dump. playarea = You are leaving the combat area. roundstop = This round is over!
objective1 = Fuel Dump objective2 = North Bridge objective3 = South Bridge objective4 = Petite Farm

content.brief: A battle for bridges as the Germans attempt to recapture a vital fuel dump. Primary objectives are the bridges. Secondary objectives are the fuel dump and local farm.
